---
title: "Mathlib & PhysLean Contribution SRS"
---

> Specify the Mathlib and PhysLean contribution guidelines as governed, uniquely-identified requirements that a Rust tool can validate and render to a website

Generated from a Varro requirements specification: every guideline for contributing to [Mathlib](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4) and [PhysLean / Physlib](https://github.com/leanprover-community/physlib) is a uniquely-identified, typed requirement. **Do not edit these pages by hand** — edit the `varro/*.varro` sources and re-run `srs-site generate`.

**60 requirements** — 54 apply to Mathlib, 22 to PhysLean.

## Obligation levels

| Level | Count |
|---|---:|
| SHALL | 30 |
| SHALL NOT | 1 |
| SHOULD | 19 |
| MAY | 3 |
| INFO | 7 |
